descripcion: The Printaura-Woocommerce WordPress plugin through 4.0.2 does not properly restrict access to the WooCommerce REST API, causing every WooCommerce REST route to accept unauthenticated requests, which allows unauthenticated attackers to read and modify store data including customer orders and personal information, store and payment settings, and webhooks. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin before 1.58.4 does not verify that a Stripe Checkout payment has completed before returning a pending submission's after-payment response, allowing unauthenticated visitors to obtain the post-payment redirect URL and thank-you message of a payment-gated form without paying. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin before 1.58.4 does not enforce payment on the server side when a form's configured payment gateway is unavailable, allowing unauthenticated visitors to complete a payment-gated User Registration form without paying and be assigned the form's configured role, up to administrator, after the gateway has been connected and later disconnected. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Download Manager WordPress plugin before 3.3.73, Download Manager WordPress plugin before 7.6.2 does not verify a package's configured role restriction when validating a package password, allowing an unauthenticated user who knows the password of a role-restricted package to obtain a download key and download the protected file. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Download Manager WordPress plugin before 3.3.73, Download Manager WordPress plugin before 7.6.2 does not verify that a visitor is allowed to access a package before its media-preview renderers issue a download key for it, allowing unauthenticated visitors to download password-locked and role-restricted files by reading the key from a public page. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Data Tables Generator by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.15.8 does not perform any authorization or ownership check before returning the stored contents of a table, relying only on a nonce that is exposed to every anonymous visitor, allowing unauthenticated users to read the full contents of any table by its identifier, including tables that are never published anywhere on the site. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin before 5.3.2 does not enforce its payment-before-login restriction when a registration is submitted without a membership selection, allowing unauthenticated users to create an account on a payment-gated registration form and log in without completing payment. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin before 5.3.2 does not verify that a payment has actually been completed before extending a paid membership subscription, allowing authenticated users with an active paid subscription to renew it indefinitely without paying. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin before 5.3.2 does not verify that a discount coupon applied to a paid membership plan is actually valid for that plan before treating a fully discounted order as paid, allowing unauthenticated users to be granted the role mapped to a paid plan without paying for it, which can lead to privilege escalation up to administrator where a plan is mapped to a privileged role. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Code Snippets WordPress plugin before 4.1.0 does not verify network-level capabilities before honouring a network-scope parameter on its snippet import routes on multisite, allowing an administrator of a single subsite without network-management rights to create, overwrite and deactivate network-wide snippets belonging to the whole network. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis
